analysis.insight_summary: The user is searching for SCCR (Short Circuit Current Rating) values for a specific [product_name] to satisfy UL508a certification requirements. Available manuals do not seem to provide these technical details, which makes certification planning challenging and leaves the user uncertain about compliance steps.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects technical documentation to clearly include SCCR values for [product_name], making certification easier. Compliance information should be easy to access and integrated into standard manuals and resources.
